blind_target.authors: Derwing, T. M., & Munro, M. J.
blind_target.title: Accent, intelligibility, and comprehensibility: Evidence from four L1s.
blind_target.evidence_quote: It conceptually replicated studies by Munro and Derwing (1995a) and Derwing and Munro (1997), who found partial independence among the three speech dimensions but also evidence that proficiency may mediate the relationship between linguistic features of stimuli (e.g., phonemic and grammatical error rates) and speech dimensions.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The abstract identifies the replicated studies but reports no comparison of the present findings to their results.
